rationale: The bundle budget only ever says SMALLER. Followed exactly, a rule that only says smaller defers the entire product: every surface is cheaper absent. This file is the counter-rule, and it is DECLARED rather than inferred, because no measurement can tell you which surfaces a user must not have to wait for.

mustBeStaticallyReachable.reason: The first-run card is the first thing a first-run user is shown. Behind a lazy chunk with a null fallback the invitation arrives LATE — a blank stage, then a card popping in — and it arrives latest on the entry-level machines product principle 3 targets. A surface whose whole job is to be there when you first look cannot be the one that loads last.

This component OWNS the OS-drop listener: subscribeNativeImportLifecycle runs in its mount effect, so the shell is deaf to a drop until this module has loaded. There is no second listener and no error — a file dropped in that window is simply gone. Deferred once already, under a comment claiming the listener mounted with the stage; it did not.

The empty stage's only next step (<ux_quality> 6: a fresh project shows a real empty state with one next step). A new project that shows nothing at all for a chunk fetch is the state this surface exists to prevent.
The surface that explains a failed start. Loading it on demand means fetching a chunk at precisely the moment the app has proven it cannot be trusted to fetch chunks.
Where every confirmation and refusal is shown (<ux_quality> 2: feedback at the gesture). A toast that cannot render yet is a refusal the user never sees.
Carries connection state — including 'not connected'. Absent, the shell looks fine while being unreachable.

North star #2's only control, and it is on the stage from the first frame. It used to be three clicks and a scroll inside a collapsed disclosure in the Build workspace, where being lazy cost nothing because nobody could reach it quickly anyway; as the stage composer it is one of the first things on screen, and a front door that pops in after a chunk fetch is the same defect as an empty state that arrives late. Measured: +8,137 bytes on the entry, of which 6,220 is the lazy chunk it replaces.

mustNotBeStaticallyReachable.reason: Reached only by selecting its viewport tool, and substantial. On demand, with a named loading state.
Opened by Ctrl/Cmd+K. On demand, with a named loading state in the modal it will occupy.
A rail destination, and the largest single workspace.
A rail destination that drags in the graph vendor bundle.
